source.property_label_policy: declared rdf:Property labels in English or without a language tag
source.scope: Gold is evaluation-only. Count and label queries are independent of all questions and gold. Recall covers existing predicate IRI constants mentioned in gold, excludes variable predicates, and is lexical retrieval only, not execution accuracy.
source.gold_reference_policy: Literal/comment contents are masked, declared prefixes are expanded and a shorthand names rdf:type. References are intersected with existing predicate IRIs; variable predicates are not counted.

legacy_metadata.method: Fixed half-common and half-question schema budget, with actual runtime tokenization and balancing helpers. Selection receives independently retrieved vocabulary and question words before gold is read. Declared English or untagged property labels only. This is retrieval coverage, not model answer accuracy or latency.
